title: Patch: Efficiency Dividend's heal choice names the heal the card gives, and choice words take a card's tunable numbers from the card
thread:
**Issue #4033 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4033: Patch: Efficiency Dividend's heal choice names the heal the card gives, and choice words take a card's tunable numbers from the card
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a player casts Efficiency Dividend and picks how to spend it, the heal choice reads "Heal 4X: Heal a target by four times X", or eight times on the Radiant card. A balance patch changed the card to heal three times X (six on the Radiant face), and the choice was never updated. With X = 3, the screen promises 12 and the card heals 9. The Chinese text repeats the old numbers.

Once built, the choice shows the card's real number. If a later patch tunes the card again, the choice follows it, and a test stops this kind of mismatch from coming back.

## Why

**The wrong text**
- `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts:26`: the base face's heal choice reads "Heal 4X" / "Heal a target by four times X."
- `modeText.ts:352`: the Radiant face reads "Heal 8X" / "eight times X". The same face's damage choice spells its multiple out too ("Deal 2X damage" / "twice X").
- `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json:2138-2142` holds the same old numbers.

**What the card really does**
- `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `core-024`: the declared `heal` is 3 on the base face and 6 on the Radiant face, and the Radiant `damage` is 2 (`tunedOn: radiant`). The face text is "heal a target {heal}X".
- `crates/cards/src/scripts/core/c024_efficiency_dividend.rs:3-5`: "heal a target 3X … 6X (4X and 8X through v0.5.2, declared numbers, … issue #2179)".

**Why nothing caught it**
- `modeText.ts`'s own header (lines 4–5) says the map names "no number a card declares (its `params`), which a patch may tune". Lines 26 and 352 break that rule.
- Nothing checks it: `modeText.test.ts` (#2646) only checks that every option has words.
- `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.test.tsx:297` and `:303` assert the old "four times X" and "eight times X", so the tests lock the bug in.

**The tool already exists.** `fillParams` (`apps/web/src/wire/catalog.ts:357`), through `abilityLabel` (`apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx`), fills a `{key}` from the card's declared numbers and the view's live `params`, as Activate labels already do.

## Proposal

- Let a `MODE_TEXT` label or detail carry its card's `{key}` placeholders. Fill them through `fillParams` from the card's face, using its live `params` where the prompt has the card instance and the printed value where it does not. That happens where `Prompt.tsx` draws the choice cards (around lines 372, 434 and 793).
- Efficiency Dividend, both faces: "Heal {heal}X" / "Heal a target by {heal} times X." On the Radiant face, the damage choice becomes "Deal {damage}X damage". The zh-CN table gets the placeholder strings.
- New check in `modeText.test.ts`: for every card in `MODE_TEXT` that declares `params`, no label or detail writes a digit or number word ("twice", "four times", …) that stands for one of those params; the number comes from a placeholder. A fixed number that no param holds, such as "X plus 1", stays allowed, and the test names the words it allows. Today it fails on lines 26 and 352.
- `Prompt.test.tsx` checks against the catalog's values, not hand-typed numbers.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts`, `apps/web/src/game/modeText.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`
- SPEC §8 Core #24 (Efficiency Dividend); CLAUDE.md rules 7 and 9; #2179 (the heal change); #2646 (the map's coverage test)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Efficiency Dividend's heal choice names the catalog's `heal` value: 3 on the base face, 6 on the Radiant face, in English and in zh-CN.
- [ ] The Radiant damage choice takes its number from the card's `damage` value.
- [ ] A hand card whose view `params` move its `heal` shows the moved number.
- [ ] The new `modeText.test.ts` check fails on today's map and passes after the change.
- [ ] These pass: `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/modeText.test.ts src/game/Prompt.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`.

## Size and risks

Medium but small: about 5 files, client only, no engine change and no ruling.

Risk: the zh-CN strings must keep the same placeholders. The existing check that every English string has a zh-CN entry catches a missing one.

---

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43788974184)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Make Efficiency Dividend's choice cards interpolate the card definition's `damage` and `heal` params, showing printed base/Radiant values when only the source face is known and a visible hand instance's live values when available. Keep English and Simplified Chinese mode copy on the same placeholders, and add a map-level regression check that rejects hard-coded X multipliers while preserving the fixed `X plus 1` mana wording.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | Kind | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts` | change | Replace Core #24's hard-coded base/Radiant heal and Radiant damage multipliers in `MODE_TEXT`/`RADIANT_MODE_TEXT` with `{heal}`/`{damage}` placeholders. |
| `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx` | change | Add one mode-word formatter around `modeText` and `fillParams`; use it in `laneAnswers`, `pickerForPending`, and `pickerForNeed`. |
| `apps/web/src/game/modeText.test.ts` | change | Add the catalog-backed invariant over `MODE_TEXT` and `RADIANT_MODE_TEXT` that declared X multipliers are placeholders, not digit/number-word literals. |
| `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.test.tsx` | change | Replace Core #24's stale literal expectations with catalog-derived base/Radiant expectations and cover a hand card's live `params`. |
| `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Replace the stale Core #24 option translations with keys/translations carrying identical `{heal}`/`{damage}` placeholders. |

Do not touch `crates/engine`, `crates/cards` (including `catalog.json`, scripts, or patch fragments), `crates/ai`, generated wire files, the spec, or any ruling note; this is client presentation over already-correct card data. SPEC §5's card text/params contract and R386 govern current values, SPEC §8.2 Core #24 governs the 3/6 heal and Radiant 2 damage multiples plus fixed X+1 mana, and SPEC §10.6, §10.8, §10.10 with R81 govern prompt rendering and hidden information. CLAUDE.md rules 7 and 9 apply; no new ruling is needed.

**Steps.**

1. In `apps/web/src/game/modeText.ts`, change Core #24's base `heal` entry to label `Heal {heal}X` and detail `Heal a target by {heal} times X.`. In `RADIANT_MODE_TEXT["core-024"]`, use `Deal {damage}X damage` / `Deal {damage}X damage.` for `damage`, the same `{heal}` label/detail pair for `heal`, and leave `mana` as `Gain X plus 1 mana next turn.` because §8.2 says that 1 is a fixed card constant rather than a declared param. Update the file header to say declared numbers use placeholders filled from the definition/visible instance instead of saying mode words name no declared number.
2. In `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx`, import `fillParams` from `@jackioh/shared` and add a local `filledModeText(lookup, defId, option, radiant, card?)` helper beside `laneAnswers`. It must call `modeText` first so lookup/translation happens while `{key}` is intact; obtain the face's `CardDef` through the existing `CardLookup`; for each returned label/detail, call `fillParams` using a shallow definition whose selected face text is that string, the base/Radiant face, and `card?.params`. If the source id/definition is unavailable, return `modeText` unchanged so unknown choices retain today's fallback. Keep this helper local rather than widening `abilityLabel`: modes have both a label and detail and, unlike an Activate label, may have only a printed source face and no instance.
3. Thread the existing `CardLookup` and optional visible `CardView` through every mode-copy construction in `Prompt.tsx`: extend `laneAnswers` to accept them; extend `pickerForPending` to accept `lookup` and use `filledModeText` with no card (printed face values); pass `lookup` from `Prompt` into `pickerForPending`; and in `pickerForNeed`'s `mode` branch use the `played.card` argument so a hand card's live values win. Pending items must keep the engine's `option.label` (it may already carry a rolled number) and take only the formatted mode detail; lane and inline mode items take both formatted fields. Use the same inputs for inline and pending `laneAnswers` calls. Do not calculate a value from X or inspect engine state; only substitute public catalog values or the visible view's `params`.
4. In `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, remove the old `Deal 2X damage`, `Deal twice X damage.`, `Heal 4X`, `Heal a target by four times X.`, `Heal 8X`, and `Heal a target by eight times X.` entries. Add exactly `"Deal {damage}X damage": "造成{damage}X点伤害"`, `"Deal {damage}X damage.": "造成{damage}X点伤害。"`, `"Heal {heal}X": "恢复{heal}X"`, and `"Heal a target by {heal} times X.": "为一个目标恢复{heal}倍X点生命值。"`. Preserve each placeholder name exactly so `i18n.test.ts`'s token-parity check passes, and leave the `Gain X plus 1 mana next turn.` entry unchanged.
5. In `apps/web/src/game/modeText.test.ts`, import `CATALOG`, `MODE_TEXT`, and `RADIANT_MODE_TEXT`. Add a test named `a card with params uses placeholders for its X multipliers` and a named `RAW_X_MULTIPLIER` matcher for digit coefficients (`2X`) plus English number-word coefficients (`twice X`, `four times X`, and the corresponding zero-through-twenty/once forms). Examine both maps only for ids whose catalog definition declares `params`, flatten every option's label/detail, and report `<id> <face> <option>: <words>` for each match. Assert the violations are empty; explicitly prove/name the allowed fixed forms by asserting plain `X` and `X plus 1` do not match, while representative old forms (`4X`, `twice X`, `four times X`) do. This makes the pre-fix Core #24 entries fail without treating the fixed mana `1` as a param.
6. In `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.test.tsx`, import `CATALOG` and the existing shared `withCatalog` test mount. Replace the stale test with `#24 Efficiency Dividend's choices read printed and live params from the card (§8 #24)`: locate `damage`/`heal` in `CATALOG["core-024"].params` and fail clearly if missing; render Prompt under `withCatalog`; assert the inline base heal label/detail use the catalog base value, the inline Radiant damage/heal label/details use their catalog Radiant values, and both mana details stay X/X+1. Also render a `pendingFor("mode", ...)` with Core #24's source id/face but no source instance and assert its mode detail falls back to the printed face, then render an inline choice whose hand `CardView.params.heal` is moved one step from the printed base value and assert the heal label/detail use that live value. Build every expected numeric phrase from the catalog/live values rather than typing 3, 6, or 2 into the assertions.

**Tests.**

- `apps/web/src/game/modeText.test.ts`: `a card with params uses placeholders for its X multipliers` rejects the old hard-coded digit and English-number coefficients in both face maps, accepts placeholder/plain-X/fixed-X+1 wording, and retains the existing #2646 coverage tests.
- `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.test.tsx`: `#24 Efficiency Dividend's choices read printed and live params from the card (§8 #24)` proves printed inline and pending-face interpolation plus a visible hand instance's tuned heal value, with expected numbers read from `CATALOG`.
- Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/modeText.test.ts src/game/Prompt.test.tsx`.
- Run `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`.
- Run `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`.

**Done when.**

- [ ] Base Efficiency Dividend shows heal 3X and Radiant shows damage 2X/heal 6X from catalog params in English.
- [ ] Simplified Chinese uses the same placeholders and therefore renders the same catalog/live values.
- [ ] A visible hand card with a changed `params.heal` shows that changed multiplier.
- [ ] The new map-level regression check would reject today's 4X/8X/twice/four-times/eight-times literals and allows the fixed X+1 mana wording.
- [ ] The two targeted Vitest files pass.
- [ ] Web typecheck and ESLint pass.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass without generated or spec changes.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes and `git status --short` lists only the five planned files.

**Risks.** Translating after interpolation would make the new dictionary keys miss, so translate first and run `fillParams` second. Pending prompts expose only a public source id/face, so they must use printed definition values; only an actually visible `CardView` may supply live params, preserving §10.8 hidden-information boundaries. Keep unknown definitions/options unchanged and keep X+1 out of substitution because it is not a declared param. No engine behavior, replay/state shape, determinism, legality, generated wire contract, or app README contract changes.

**Open questions.** None; §8.2 and the catalog settle all values and the task requires no new ruling.
```
